meta.titulo: Used Porsche Boxster and Cayman 987 for sale · Valentín Motors
meta.descripcion: Porsche Boxster and Cayman type 987, from 2005 to 2012, inspected on 111 points: IMS and bore scoring on the first series, PDK on the second. Twelve-month warranty.

parrafos: The second Boxster generation brings the Cayman, the mid-engined coupé many consider the best-balanced Porsche of its time. The first series (2005-2008) uses 2.7 and 3.4 engines, with the Cayman S at 295 hp; the second (2009-2012) moves to direct injection, 2.9 and 3.4 with up to 320 hp, and introduces the PDK. The Boxster Spyder and the Cayman R close the range.
A 987.2 is an engine without IMS and with PDK, with almost no known weak points. A 987.1 is cheaper and needs the same inspection as a 997.1. Knowing which is which is half the purchase.

secciones.titulo: What we check on a 987 before selling it
items: IMS on the first series: bearing and documented replacements.
Bore scoring on the first-series 3.4: borescope inspection and oil consumption.
PDK on the second series: oil and filter service and cold behaviour.
Front radiators and condensers, hood on the Boxster and tailgate seals on the Cayman.
Clutch, brakes, PASM if fitted and match of options with the Porsche certificate.

secciones.titulo: Buying a Boxster or Cayman 987 at Valentín Motors
parrafos: Every Porsche 987 Boxster and Cayman we sell goes through our 111-point inspection, leaves with a twelve-month or 10,000 km warranty on engine and gearbox, and its certified mileage is stated on the sales invoice. We have been Porsche specialists since 1979, with our own workshops in Barcelona and Madrid: the car you buy here has been on our lift before it reaches your hands.
If you have found the one you want elsewhere, we can also check it for you before you pay for it: pre-purchase inspection.
